mapper.insert: INSERT INTO antagonisms (id, kind, piece_id, piece_code, piece_name, piece_alias, conflict_piece_id, conflict_piece_code, conflict_piece_name, conflict_piece_alias) VALUES (#{id}, #{kind}, #{pieceId}, #{pieceCode}, #{pieceName}, #{pieceAlias}, #{conflictPieceId}, #{conflictPieceCode}, #{conflictPieceName}, #{conflictPieceAlias})
mapper.update: UPDATE antagonisms SET kind = #{kind}, piece_id = #{pieceId}, piece_code = #{pieceCode}, piece_name = #{pieceName}, piece_alias = #{pieceAlias}, conflict_piece_id = #{conflictPieceId}, conflict_piece_code = #{conflictPieceCode}, conflict_piece_name = #{conflictPieceName} conflict_piece_alias = #{conflictPieceAlias} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM antagonisms WHERE (piece_id = #{pieceId} AND conflict_piece_id = #{conflictPieceId}) OR (piece_id = #{conflictPieceId} AND conflict_piece_id = #{pieceId})
